gaps.sentence: You risk ___ your licence if you drink and drive.
My boss won't ___ me take Friday off.
gaps.explanation: let + object + bare infinitive: won't let me take. (allow/permit take to: allow me to take.)

gaps.sentence: We managed ___ everyone before the storm hit.
Don't forget ___ off the lights when you leave.
gaps.explanation: forget + to-infinitive = fail to do a duty: forget to turn.

gaps.sentence: He apologized for ___ so abrupt in the meeting.

gaps.explanation: happen + to-infinitive = do something by chance: happen to know.

gaps.sentence: After introducing herself, she went on ___ the main findings.
gaps.hint: move on to a new activity
gaps.explanation: go on + to-infinitive = do something after finishing something else.

gaps.sentence: They managed ___ the fire before it spread.
gaps.explanation: manage takes the to-infinitive: managed to put out.
